hook: Where do all the tees even go?
setting: Standing on a tee box, tee markers beside them and fairway stretching out behind, full-body framing with grass under their feet.
action: Mulligan pats around empty-handed; Birdie asks, Mulligan reveals the babyhood reason.
sound: birdsong, a frustrated grumble, a tiny gum-smack
judge: 'Teething' is a crisp one-word baby reveal that surprises.
